source.title: Telemetry and Observability for Claude Code

title: Seeing What Your AI Actually Does
subtitle: Turning raw agent telemetry into cost, patterns, and guardrails
visualConcept: An abstract data-observability scene: layered translucent waveform and metric-stream lines in warm coral and amber tones flowing left to right across the dark right panel, converging into a single glowing baseline graph or pulse line that steadies into a calm horizontal signal, evoking telemetry turning noise into a trustworthy baseline. No dashboards, no screens, no logos, purely abstract light and line art.
style: modern editorial tech illustration, soft gradient lighting, clean geometric abstraction, subtle grain texture, high contrast typography-friendly left zone
